title: Emergency Room Charges and the Late-Change Fee on Outpatient Surgery Packages
content:
A recent emergency room visit at Riverbend lowers the share of the fee basis kept when a patient moves a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking late under Good Faith & Price Estimates. The emergency room charge is read from the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) records.

**Rule.** The latest emergency room charge is the emergency room charge line (revenue code 0450) on the patient's Riverbend hospital accounts with the latest service date, the first such line the account activity lists where several share that date, and it counts only when the hospital account it is posted on carries charges net of the charge credits recorded on that account above zero, otherwise counting as no emergency room charge, an earlier emergency room charge not being looked for. When the latest emergency room charge has a service date on the change date or the day before it, one half (0.5) of the fee basis is kept; when it is dated two to seven days before the change date (7 days at most), three quarters (0.75) are kept; in every other case, no emergency room charge and one dated after the change date included, all of it is kept.

| Latest emergency room charge, measured against the change date | Share of the fee basis kept |
|---|---|
| on the change date, or 1 day before | one half (0.5) |
| 2 to 7 days before | three quarters (0.75) |
| 8 or more days before | all of it |
| dated after the change date | all of it |
| none, or its account's net charges are zero or less | all of it |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Latest emergency room line dated 7 days before the change date on an account with net charges of 900.00: three quarters kept.
- Latest line dated the day before the change date, but its account's charges are fully credited: treated as no emergency room charge, all kept — an older emergency room line on another account is not looked for.
- Two emergency room lines share the latest service date: the first one listed decides which account is tested.
